rationale_summary: The document centers on protecting personal information rights of data subjects when public institutions deploy AI. The governance justification is framed around preventing privacy violations, ensuring legal bases for data processing, and protecting sensitive groups such as children—core fundamental rights concerns under Korea's Personal Information Protection Act.
